description: Land Acquisition - Mehiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, land names, uses, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned.
